name: Streamer's Journey 💖
description:
STORY

Tania is a young streamer with low self-esteem who, manipulated by her friend Eidzoku, dives into the world of explicit photo shoots and online exploitation. In search of validation and confidence, she receives a flood of attention, but her life gradually spirals out of balance. Her dependence on online approval deepens, and her real-life relationships fall apart.

As Tania becomes entangled in manipulative, toxic relationships and subjected to humiliation by a group known as "The Aristocrats," she is victimized by violence. However, her inner traumas and deviant tendencies only intensify. As she sinks further into this dark world, Tania loses control of her life, becoming a victim of her own insecurities and destructive desires.

GAMEPLAY

This story-driven visual novel delves deep into the emotional and psychological journey of the protagonist, Tania. The game focuses on exploring her inner struggles, insecurities, and the impact of toxic relationships through a captivating narrative. Players will experience detailed and explicit sexual scenes that are integral to revealing Tania’s state of mind, reflecting her complex emotions and evolving psychological state.

The linear storyline emphasizes the character’s development, offering a raw and immersive exploration of her life. The game also features a wealth of high-quality artwork, ensuring that every scene, whether intimate or emotional, is depicted with careful attention to detail and artistry.

FEATURES

• Exciting story

• Thrilling art
